io_contract.record: appended before the engine is called; never removed except by seal
io_contract.seal: zip is read back and CRC/digest verified before the journal is trimmed
io_contract.digest: deterministic, assembled from on-disk records, no model call

io_contract.failure: safe_* wrappers return {ok:false,error} and the turn continues
io_contract.boot: a broken compaction module degrades the record, never the console

release_tag: build-line 2026-09-24 · the picture engine travels INSIDE the package: the CPU build of stable-diffusion.cpp ships in tools/sd-cpu (45 MB, 20 files, no CUDA, no admin), and media_root() falls back to the KIT ROOT when the machine has no media root of its own - so a fresh all-in-one install draws a picture with no config at all, while a machine that has its own media root (a studio PC with its CUDA build and checkpoints) keeps it untouched · no checkpoint is redistributed (SDXL Turbo is Stability's non-commercial research licence, SD 1.5 is CreativeML Open RAIL-M): tools/sd-cpu/get_model.ps1, double-clickable as FETCH_IMAGE_MODEL.bat, fetches one from its author's repo, resumable and size-checked, and names the licence · carried from 1.3.1: turn performance, measured not estimated: every turn records what it GENERATED vs what it SHOWED and attributes the gap (limb calls, reasoning, superseded text, a residual) — `last_perf` in /api/health, one line in the console log, a "Shown to you" row plus the gap on the status line · the asked shape sets the turn: "reply with exactly X" caps max_tokens (4096 -> 24 on the measured ask) and offers NO limb schema; "one word" / "N sentences" / "N items" cap and stop the same way · the streamed read stops the moment the asked shape is complete, which closes the connection and cuts the engine's own generation (engine counter 1 -> 5 tokens for the whole probe, vs 412 for three turns before) · streamed turns report the engine's own timings at last (stream_options.include_usage — before this a streamed turn recorded `perf: {}`) · prefix-cache reuse published per turn (cache_hit_pct) · LYGO_TURNPERF=0 restores the previous behaviour exactly · measured on the PC copy, same two-word ask: 2.84 s / 106 generated / 6 shown / 94% unseen -> 1.03 s / 2 generated / 2 shown / 0% unseen · carried from 1.3.0: engine window 16384, over-window turns answer instead of 500, fabrication detector, straight sampling (temp 0.25), COMPLEX TASKS + STYLE in the align prompt, qwen2.5-coder:7b on both copies
